newsitem.title: USA: U.S. debt futures finish quiet session mixed.
newsitem.headline: U.S. debt futures finish quiet session mixed.

text.p: U.S. debt futures finished a very quiet session mixed, with March T-bonds slightly lower.
Players said trade was uneventful ahead of a shortened session Tuesday and the New Year's Day holiday Wednesday.
Bond futures and all other Chicago Board of Trade products will close early Tuesday at 1210 CST/1810 GMT, and Eurodollar futures trading at the Chicago Mercantile Exchange will cease at 1200 CST.
Overall trade Monday was very light, with few standout players seen, floor brokers said.

"We traded most of the session (in March T-bonds) 113-29/32 to 114-06/32 and we traded down a little bit toward the end of the day, but there was no news or nothing of any size," a T-bond floor source said.
Resistance was pegged at the overnight Project A and day session high of 114-06/32. Technicians said that level also represents the 50 percent retracement of the 116-17/32 to 111-27/32 downmove.
"We expect more of the same tomorrow even though we've got a few numbers," he said.

The National Association of Purchasing Management-Chicago will release its Chicagoland business barometer at 0900 CST/1500 GMT Tuesday. It is forecast at 55.6, compared with 57.6 in the previous report.
Also due Tuesday are the New York NAPM, November new home sales and December consumer confidence.
Early in Monday's session, the Conference Board reported U.S. November leading indicators up 0.1 percent after an unchanged reading in October.
November existing home sales rose 1.8 percent to a seasonally adjusted annual rate of 4.04 million units.

The APICS business outlook for December was 51.8, up from 46.8 in November. APICS and new home sales early Monday were slightly stronger than expected, pulling March T-bonds from their 114-6/32 session high.
At settlement, March T-bonds were down 2/32 to 113-28/32, 10-year T-notes were 1/32 lower at 109-29/32 and muni-bonds were 6/32 higher at 117-06/32. June Eurodollars closed flat at 94.33.
